title: Coverage ledger
description: coverage/<batch>.json: what one extraction session covered at one commit. Coverage checks that the ledgers for the modelled commit account for every required file.

commit.description: Full commit the files were read at; must equal meta.source.commit.

summary.description: What this batch covered, e.g. `crates/axo-pty and crates/axo-ipc`.

path.description: A file, or a directory ending in `/` for development, vendored, and generated trees.

outcome.description: read: read in full in an extraction session (recorded automatically). development: about developing, building, or publishing the system rather than how it behaves, with a note saying what it is for. vendored or generated: copied or produced by a tool, with a note naming the origin.

note.description: Required in spirit for vendored and generated: where it comes from.

hash.description: For reads of a model of the working tree: the content hash (git blob id) of what was read. The read counts only while the file still has this content.
